gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.002416 40.754471)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
tri_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_TRI(rast, 1) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(t.rast, 1, o.pt) AS tri_value
FROM tri_rast t, origin o;

WITH equinox_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Equinox'
    AND addr_city = 'New York'
    AND addr_state = 'NY'
),
ruggedness_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Envelope(geometry) AS geom
  FROM equinox_geom
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
      rast,
      true,
      (SELECT geom FROM ruggedness_area)
    ) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM ruggedness_area)
    )
),
ruggedness_index AS (
  SELECT ST_Ruggedness(rast, 1) AS ruggedness
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ruggedness
FROM ruggedness_index;
